score_nature: Ordinal preparation milestone, not probability of profit or capital loss
criterion_frozen_from_previous_delivery: Datos observados causales utilizables, costes y patrimonio conciliados, comparación reproducible y pareada del motor, Ridge y control.
required_together: Nonempty usable observed data with decision-time availability and source lineage
Continuous account NAV, cash, positions and external-flow reconciliation
Observed economic cost coverage; unknown expenses cannot be converted to zero
C0 native, Ridge and SVR compared over the same funded interval, market input, account constraints, costs and coordinator exits
Numeric predictor and receipt reproductions bound to model, source, configuration and wealth-path hashes
No unvalidated local software result substituted for external observation
permitted_actions: Read-only market data and authorized resource discovery
historical_quote_probe_selection: Final session of the previously retained January-September archive, at its existing 10:50 and15:20 diagnostic grids; no PnL used to choose it
stop_rule: After the scoped engineering gaps are fixed and relevant tests pass, run readiness on available evidence. Report exact unresolved resource requirements. Do not widen strategy search or change the score criterion to manufacture level4.
independence: Internal review in shared workspace, not blind external validation
